name: tau_ai_orchestrator
purpose: Top-level execution layer that tells the AI how to combine doctrine, faction dossiers, Tau doctrine, runtime logic, threat analysis, deployment patterns, matchup logic, target priority, and mission/core rules into one coherent battlefield decision process.

execution_pipeline.name: ingest_battle_context
execution_pipeline.action: Read mission, terrain, Tau list, enemy faction, enemy list, and turn/score state.

execution_pipeline.name: load_tau_self_model
execution_pipeline.action: Load Tau parsed dossier, Tau detachment doctrine library, Tau unit roles and synergies, and Tau commander runtime.

execution_pipeline.name: load_enemy_model
execution_pipeline.action: Load the relevant enemy parsed dossier and classify enemy units with the enemy threat analysis engine.

execution_pipeline.name: apply_strategy_layer
execution_pipeline.action: Use the strategy principles library to interpret the matchup at a high level: deception, patience, concentration, adaptation, effective first strike, and decision-quality constraints.

execution_pipeline.name: select_tau_detachment
execution_pipeline.action: Use tau_commander_runtime detachment_selection_rules, then validate against tau_detachment_doctrine_library and the actual Tau list.

execution_pipeline.name: select_deployment_pattern
execution_pipeline.action: Use the deployment_pattern_library plus matchup/threat context to select the highest-confidence deployment pattern.

execution_pipeline.name: assign_tau_unit_roles
execution_pipeline.action: Map Tau units into screens, anchors, hammers, utility pieces, and objective flip packages using tau_unit_roles_and_synergies plus tau_commander_runtime role_assignment_rules.

execution_pipeline.name: build_target_priority_plan
execution_pipeline.action: Use the enemy threat map, matchup_strategy_library, and target_priority_matrix to produce the target order for the next turn cycle.

execution_pipeline.name: build_opening_plan
execution_pipeline.action: Use tau_commander_runtime turn_sequence_engine and the selected detachment/deployment to create turn 1-3 goals and commitment timing.

execution_pipeline.name: update_in_game
execution_pipeline.action: After each enemy commitment, use tau_commander_runtime enemy_commitment_update_rules and mission overrides to revise role assignments, target priority, and trade thresholds.

always_prioritize: clean removals over broad chip damage unless scoring or bracketing demands otherwise
survival of premium Tau assets until their best timing window
never_assume: that the first visible target is the right target
that the biggest enemy model is automatically priority one
that Tau should always attack first
that a favorable kill is worthwhile if it loses the scoring posture

during_game: whether the AI should press, hold, or reposition
